summary: Xbox's choice-driven Albion RPG series; use PC Anniversary for the first game, Xbox backward compatibility for Fable II, PC where it adds unique modes, and mark canceled/defunct service titles honestly.

entries.title: Fable

emulation.notes: Use Fable Anniversary on Windows; original Xbox emulation is only for original-version comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Fable Anniversary at highest stable settings

primary.why: Fable began on Xbox in 2004, was expanded as The Lost Chapters, and later remastered as Fable Anniversary. The Windows version of Fable Anniversary is the highest-fidelity and most complete official route for the original game content.
primary.how_to_play: Play Fable Anniversary on Windows at the highest stable settings; use The Lost Chapters only if you prefer the original presentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Fable Anniversary remaster with The Lost Chapters content and PC display flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most complete official route.
skip: original route but superseded for content and fidelity by Fable Anniversary.

all_releases.platform: Xbox / Windows / Mac OS X - The Lost Chapters
all_releases.fidelity: Expanded edition with additional story and content.
all_releases.reason: skip: important classic expanded edition, but Anniversary includes the expanded content with higher fidelity.
skip: strong console remaster route but no content advantage over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Fable Anniversary on Windows combines the expanded Lost Chapters content with the highest official fidelity.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Lost Chapters preserves the older presentation; Anniversary is the recommended remaster route for normal play.

primary.why: Pub Games is an Xbox 360-only tie-in with three minigames that can feed gold/items into Fable II.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360/XBLA release if owned; use it before Fable II only if you want the transfer economy/items.

all_releases.fidelity: XBLA minigame tie-in with Keystone, Fortune's Tower, and Spinnerbox.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Tie-in value depends on Fable II transfer/support availability.

entries.title: Fable II
entries.definitive_edition: Fable II: Game of the Year

emulation.notes: Use Xbox One/Series backward compatibility or original Xbox 360 hardware.

primary.platform: Xbox 360 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S
primary.version: Game of the Year with DLC via backward compatibility
primary.why: Fable II is Xbox 360-only; Game of the Year includes the two DLC packs, and backward compatibility is the best current modern-console route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Game of the Year/DLC-complete Xbox 360 version on Xbox 360 or through Xbox One/Series backward compatibility.

all_releases.reason: skip: use the DLC-complete Game of the Year route.

all_releases.platform: Xbox 360 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S
all_releases.fidelity: Game of the Year package with Knothole Island and See the Future DLC; playable on modern Xbox through backward compatibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: DLC-complete Xbox route is the only official full route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC or modern remaster documented.

primary.why: A Hero's Tale was an online Fable II tie-in used to unlock a secret chest in the main game; it is now archival.
primary.how_to_play: No current official route is documented; treat as a defunct browser tie-in.

all_releases.fidelity: Interactive browser tie-in to Fable II.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented route, now archival.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Defunct online tie-in; current play/unlock route is not documented.

entries.title: Fable III

emulation.emulator: None for PC; Xbox backward compatibility fallback
emulation.notes: Use modern Xbox backward compatibility if PC access fails.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC release with exclusive modes

primary.why: The PC version has exclusive Hardcore mode and 3D functionality not found on Xbox 360, making it the most complete/high-ceiling version if owned.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PC version if you have a working copy; otherwise use the Xbox 360 version through backward compatibility as the practical fallback.

all_releases.reason: skip: practical current route through backward compatibility, but PC has exclusive Hardcore mode/3D.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release with Hardcore mode and 3D functionality.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete/high-ceiling version if available.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC has exclusive modes/features but is less conveniently available today; Xbox backward compatibility is the fallback route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster documented; PC availability/DRM can be a caveat.

primary.why: Fable Coin Golf was a Windows Phone tie-in to Fable III with no modern port documented.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as an archival Windows Phone title; no current official modern route is documented.

primary.why: Fable Heroes is an Xbox 360-only co-op beat 'em up spin-off that connects unlocks with Fable: The Journey.
primary.how_to_play: Play the XBLA release if owned, ideally locally or online where Xbox 360 services/compatibility permit.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Some online/service features may depend on current Xbox service availability.

primary.why: The Journey is a Kinect-only Xbox 360 spin-off, so original hardware with Kinect is the most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 with Kinect; emulation is not the recommended route because motion controls are central.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original Kinect hardware is favored over emulation for control completeness.

primary.why: Fable Legends was canceled before final release and its beta servers shut down on April 13, 2016.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a normal play route; there was no final public release.

all_releases.fidelity: Sourced pre-release, canceled, service-limited, or archival listing; no final released build comparison is available.
all_releases.reason: primary: resolved archival/pre-release row; revisit if a final playable release ships or fuller platform data appears.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Canceled server-dependent title; no final release exists.

primary.why: Fable Fortune released on Windows and Xbox One, but support was discontinued in March 2020.
primary.how_to_play: No current official route is documented; treat as a defunct online/service card game.
